svg.title: The three conditions for continuity at a point
svg.desc: Four graphs near x = c. First: an open circle and no closed dot, so f(c) is not defined and condition 1 fails. Second: a jump, so the limit at c does not exist and condition 2 fails. Third: a hole with the closed dot f(c) placed above it, so the limit exists but does not equal f(c) and condition 3 fails. Fourth: an unbroken curve through a closed dot, where all three conditions hold and f is continuous at c.
svg.text: 1: f(c) is defined. 2: the limit as x → c exists. 3: the limit equals f(c).
